category_edits.rationale: Across all four category models, jointly lower learning rate to 5e-4 and dropout to 0.2. Smaller updates may stabilize pairwise optimization, while reduced dropout preserves short-history signal and offsets slower fitting. Retain all other hyperparameters, features, HSTU computations, readout and loss. Existing metadata and predictor loading remain compatible; inference disables dropout.

response.change_summary: Jointly reduce training dropout and learning rate for all four independent HSTU category models.
